decisions.reason: Applying the corrected 1.27 mm breakout pitch to the integrated-board variant does not change the architecture, functionality-retention, or connector-elimination rules.
The breakout-header pitch does not alter the ESP32 antenna placement, direction, or keepout constraints.
The pitch correction does not change the integrated board's orientation or specified battery, USB-C, display, and general connector-placement rules.
This candidate governs connector placement on the separate three-board variant; the integrated-board breakout pitch correction does not change those rules.
The source changes an ESP32 breakout pitch and does not establish any change to enclosure accommodation, mounting, airflow, display, or retention requirements.
Although the corrected pitch may assist routing, it does not change the existing board dimensions or the requirement to provide sufficient routing space.
The ESP32 breakout pitch correction does not affect the separate power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector-access constraints.
The source concerns the ESP32 breakout on the main or integrated board and does not change the sensor board content-fit requirement.
Changing the ESP32 breakout pitch does not alter the power board's four-layer stack requirement.
The corrected pitch does not establish a change to component sourcing, availability, BOM preference, or procurement policy.
The pitch correction leaves the independently established through-hole mounting technology unchanged.
The ESP32 breakout pitch does not change the three-board interboard power topology, connector specifications, or pin-order rules.
